key_evidence: Cognition AI has never been individually assessed. rotation-state records last_assessed: null, and all eight published dimensions are set to an identical 2.5 — a bulk-import placeholder.

Three weeks after acquiring Windsurf, Cognition laid off 30 staff and offered voluntary exits to 200 others, having stated at acquisition that 100% of Windsurf employees would receive financial compensation (TechCrunch, 2025-08-05).

Employees who stayed were reportedly required to work six days in the office and more than 80-hour weeks, with CEO Scott Wu stating the company does not believe in work-life balance — the anchor-1 condition for B1 Self-Sustainability.

Offsetting: the buyout offered was nine months of salary, which is materially generous by sector standards, and the terms were communicated publicly and specifically. Action is scored at 2.6 on that basis.

THE CORE EVIDENCE IS A YEAR OUTSIDE THE WINDOW. It is dated August 2025; no in-window corroboration that the six-day, 80-hour policy remains in force was located. Two of the four sources carry no machine-verifiable date.

THIS IS NOT A DOWNGRADE. Filed as flag-for-review alongside Cerebras Systems in the same index, for coordinator-level calibration of never-assessed uniform-seed placeholders. NO score change is proposed for application.

evidence.claim: Three weeks after acquiring Windsurf, Cognition laid off 30 staffers and offered voluntary exits to 200 others, a sharp shift from its earlier statement that 100% of Windsurf employees would receive financial compensation.
Employees who chose to stay were reportedly required to spend six days at the office and work more than 80-hour weeks, with CEO Scott Wu stating the company does not believe in work-life balance.
Employees were given until 10 August to decide whether to take a buyout amounting to nine months of salary.

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — NOT A DOWNGRADE. No score change is proposed for application. The published 37.5 is a never-assessed uniform-seed placeholder (all eight dimensions identical at 2.5). The documented conduct evidence is real and specific but is dated 2025-08, twelve months outside this cycle window, with no in-window corroboration and with two of four sources undated. Conversion trigger: in-window corroboration that the six-day, 80-plus-hour working policy remains in force, or a new labour action, would convert this to a conduct proposal. rotation-state composite/band/rank left at the PUBLISHED values.
